model: claude-sonnet-5-5 (Claude Code `sonnet` subagent alias; resolved ID not confirmed by the model)
mode: one fresh subagent per question; no command access, so the tool outputs (list_facets, search with an empty query, get per entry) were read from files holding the same JSON the tools return. The subagents could not run keyword searches; they scanned the full 10-entry listing instead.
wiki_state: 10 entries, all unreviewed at the time the answers were written (fe-2026-0007 was reviewed by an agent afterwards)
isolation: subagents were told not to read evals/ (other than the prompt), entries or scouting; this was an instruction, not an enforced sandbox
